BALATRO-LOW_STAKES.title: Low Stakes
BALATRO-LOW_STAKES.description: At the start of each combat, discard any number of cards then draw that many.
BALATRO-HEADS_UP.title: Heads Up
BALATRO-HEADS_UP.description: Gain {Energy:energyIcons()} at the start of your turn.
BALATRO-NEST_EGG.title: Nest Egg
BALATRO-NEST_EGG.flavor: Some extra cash for on the way.
BALATRO-NEST_EGG.description: Gain [blue]300[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold] at the start of the run.
BALATRO-YOU_GET_WHAT_YOU_GET.title: You Get What You Get
BALATRO-YOU_GET_WHAT_YOU_GET.description: At the end of the turn gain [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold] for each card in hand. Gain no [gold]Gold[/gold] in combat rewards.
BALATRO-ROYALE.title: Royale
BALATRO-ROYALE.flavor: Is this the reward you are looking for?
BALATRO-ROYALE.description: On Card Reward screens you have [blue]2[/blue] additional cards to choose from. Lose {Energy:energyIcons()} at the start of your turn.
BALATRO-CRYSTAL_BALL.title: Crystal Ball
BALATRO-CRYSTAL_BALL.flavor: Everybody needs a little bit of magic.
BALATRO-CRYSTAL_BALL.description: Gain an extra [gold]Potion[/gold] slot and [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Duplication Potions[/gold].
BALATRO-ASTRONOMY.title: Astronomy
BALATRO-ASTRONOMY.flavor: Reach for the stars and beyond.
BALATRO-ASTRONOMY.description: After you play a card, [gold]Upgrade[/gold] it for this combat. Lose a [gold]Potion[/gold] slot.
BALATRO-CLAIRVOYANCE.title: Clairvoyance
BALATRO-CLAIRVOYANCE.flavor: Ghost usually drain the color out faces.
BALATRO-CLAIRVOYANCE.description: Combat rewards can now contain [gold]Colorless[/gold] cards. Choose a [gold]Rare Colorless[/gold] card at the start of the run.
BALATRO-FLUSHED.title: Flushed
BALATRO-FLUSHED.flavor: Red cheeks and can't look at your face, what could this be?
BALATRO-FLUSHED.description: If you have not played any [gold]Powers[/gold] during your turn, gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Dexterity[/gold] and [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold] next turn.
BALATRO-RETROGRADE.title: Retrograde
BALATRO-RETROGRADE.flavor: Quick check if everything is ready.
BALATRO-RETROGRADE.description: [gold]Upgrade[/gold] half of your deck at start of combat.
BALATRO-R_O_I.title: ROI
BALATRO-R_O_I.flavor: Lift the shop to new heights and become a star trader.
BALATRO-R_O_I.description: Cards in shops are [gold]Upgraded[/gold]. [gold]Potions[/gold] in the shops are at least [gold]Uncommon[/gold]. Guarantee one [gold]Rare[/gold] card in the shop.
BALATRO-BIG_HANDS.title: Big Hands
BALATRO-BIG_HANDS.flavor: Believe in the hands of fate.
BALATRO-BIG_HANDS.description: Draw [blue]2[/blue] additional cards each turn. On Card Reward screens, you have [blue]1[/blue] less card to choose from.
BALATRO-HIGH_STAKES.title: High Stakes
BALATRO-HIGH_STAKES.description: After selecting an Ancient relic, gain another random relic from that Ancient.
BALATRO-RULE_BENDER.title: Rule Bender
BALATRO-RULE_BENDER.description: Whenever an [gold]Attack[/gold] is played, gain half of the damage as [gold]Block[/gold]. [blue]ALL[/blue] enemies have double their health.
BALATRO-SHATTERED.title: Shattered
BALATRO-SHATTERED.description: Start with a random deck of [blue]20[/blue] cards.
BALATRO-OVERSTOCK_PLUS.title: Overstock Plus
BALATRO-OVERSTOCK_PLUS.description: Future shops have three additional relics.
BALATRO-LIQUIDATION.title: Liquidation
BALATRO-LIQUIDATION.flavor: Don't ask where I got this money from.
BALATRO-GLOW_UP.title: Glow Up
BALATRO-GLOW_UP.description: Add a random [gold]Ancient[/gold] card to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
BALATRO-REROLL_GLUT.title: Reroll Glut
BALATRO-REROLL_GLUT.flavor: The secret to a big deck.
BALATRO-REROLL_GLUT.description: Can reroll the cards in future shops, costs [blue]50[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold] per roll.
BALATRO-OMEN_GLOBE.title: Omen Globe
BALATRO-OMEN_GLOBE.flavor: All this drinking is making me see things.
BALATRO-OMEN_GLOBE.description: Whenever you use a potion in combat, create a random [gold]Colorless[/gold] card.
BALATRO-OBSERVATORY.title: Observatory
BALATRO-OBSERVATORY.flavor: Only the best get to go twice.
BALATRO-OBSERVATORY.description: The first upgraded card you play each combat is played an extra time.
BALATRO-NACHO_TONG.title: Nacho Tong
BALATRO-NACHO_TONG.description: Gain {Energy:energyIcons()} at the start of each turn.
BALATRO-RECYCLOMANCY.title: Recyclomancy
BALATRO-RECYCLOMANCY.description: Whenever you manually discard [blue]4[/blue] cards, gain [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold].
BALATRO-TAROT_TYCOON.title: Tarot Tycoon
BALATRO-TAROT_TYCOON.flavor: Drink and grow forever, little one.
BALATRO-TAROT_TYCOON.description: Whenever you obtain a potion, gain [blue]1[/blue] maximum Health.
BALATRO-PLANET_TYCOON.title: Planet Tycoon
BALATRO-PLANET_TYCOON.description: Whenever you add a [gold]Common[/gold] card to your deck, it is [gold]Upgraded[/gold].
BALATRO-MONEY_TREE.title: Money Tree
BALATRO-MONEY_TREE.flavor: You believed them when they said money doesn't grow on trees?
BALATRO-ANTIMATTER.title: Antimatter
BALATRO-ANTIMATTER.flavor: Maybe this one looks better than that one.
BALATRO-ANTIMATTER.description: Future card rewards have [blue]1[/blue] additional card to choose from.
BALATRO-ILLUSION.title: Illusion
BALATRO-ILLUSION.flavor: Your reality is an illusion for others.
BALATRO-ILLUSION.description: Choose and add a [gold]Common, Uncommon[/gold] and [gold]Rare[/gold] card to your deck.
BALATRO-PETROGLYPH.title: Petroglyph
BALATRO-PETROGLYPH.flavor: Study your enemies like they know your every move.
BALATRO-PETROGLYPH.description: Reduce the max health of all enemies by [blue]10%.[/blue]
BALATRO-RETCON.title: Retcon
BALATRO-RETCON.flavor: Predicting your enemy is half the battle.
BALATRO-RETCON.description: Can reroll a Blind, costs [blue]50[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold] per roll. (Only usable on first turn before playing a card)
BALATRO-PALETTE.title: Palette
BALATRO-PALETTE.description: At the start of your turn, draw [blue]1[/blue] additional card.
BALATRO-ARCHAIC-TOOTH.description: Upon pickup, [gold]Transform[/gold] [blue]2[/blue] starter cards into an Ancient card.
BALATRO-ARCHAIC-TOOTH.eventDescription: [gold]Transform Clever Joker[/gold] and [gold]Mad Joker[/gold] into [gold]Evolved Joker[/gold]
